dedicated._note: Dedicated Server (ui/pages/dedicated.rml): an always-on server run from this PC. Running one from the menu comes with P9: the settings here are the web menu's defaults, and Start, Stop and the console are refused. Each mode keeps its own map choice (modes[].rotation, its spinner's options in modes[].maps).
